comparison.objective: Release memory-slot latches, replace a module, and store the old module; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch release and long-edge connector insertion/extraction differ from narrow-mandrel alignment, hammer striking, fracture control, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: New module installed in A2 and old module placed in its holder versus four tangs fractured and contained with coils undisturbed. Detailed scoring tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Connector replacement and latching exercise a different tested ability from controlled impact fracture.
